title: KHR_node_visibility_hint glTF Node Extension
description: Associates a node with a per-view visibility role inherited by descendants. The role is evaluated as a predicate and does not mutate node visibility state.

role.description: Nonempty view-context role. The exact standard values are 'always', 'first_person', and 'third_person'; unrecognized values use the visible fallback under this extension.

label.description: Nonempty human-readable label for authoring tools and inspectors. It has no effect on visibility.
